name: Tilework Masjid
summary: A broad mosque built from bold cobalt steps, paired minarets, and amber ceramic blocks.
why: The roof is drawn on a three-unit grid around x54. Both minarets merge into the same hall, with matched caps and a common y69 foundation. Amber tiles replace exact sections of the facade rather than float above it.
risk: The stair-stepped dome is intentionally graphic; at 24px it reads as a terraced mosque roof.
sub1: Precise steps build the central dome
reasonToChoose: You want a mosque with a distinctive tile-like graphic language.
